note: What a chat turn sends to Langfuse as turn.v1 (amul-telemetry telemetry/turn.v1.yaml): the root, its trace fields, its amul.* metadata keys, the steps opened under it with the metadata each may carry, the scores and the outcomes. A metadata key is sent only when its value is known (farmer_id for a phone-identified user, served_tier once the agent ran). The input is the raw question, the output the answer as delivered. level and status_message are set when the turn ends as an error: level ERROR, and the reason, what the turn raised or else the path that answered it (fail-closed). The suggestions step runs after the response and nests under the root after it has closed. pydantic-ai's agent-run, model and tool spans nest under the agent step and are not listed.
